subject: RELATIVE KEY clause
notes: GR2: 'data-name-1 is used to communicate a relative record number between the user and the mass storage control system' (cite.py --check 12.4.5.13.4 "data-name-1 is used to communicate a relative record number between the user and the mass storage control system" -> OK). Both directions verified: user->system (random/dynamic READ/WRITE/START take the RRN from the key item: rk4 READ key 3 -> CCCC, WRITE key 7 then START >= 4 finds it; qualified key rk1/ClauseOperandQualificationSpecTests) and system->user (sequential WRITE stores 1,2,3; sequential READ stores the RRN of the record made available; golden l1_read_relative_key_moved clobbers the key to 9999 before each READ NEXT and expects 0001/0002/0003 and 9999 at end). The key item resolved is the data-name-1 item (qualifiers kept, FileModel.RelativeKeyQualifiers); a reference-modified slice cannot stand in for it (landed PB602 for START, ScreenClauseOperandShape for the clause).
